addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE above 82,300.0. It clears the 82,285.0 twenty-four-hour high by 15 points and reclaims the level that just rejected. decisionBox.changed: Position stays TAKE_PROFIT but the whole frame steps up and tightens. Midday ran gates at 80,000/81,500 with no stop recommended; the 81,500 add gate ARMED on the 19:00 UTC hourly close at 81,768.9 and is now 485.0 points underwater, the first settled-close gate to fail this week. Gates move to 80,750/82,300, invalidation lifts 78,240 to 80,000 onto the 1H EMA20 at 80,000.49, and the resting stop is switched ON at 80,700 because this is the last report before roughly 02:00 tomorrow and the character of the liquidation flow flipped in the final two hours: 1,361,691 USD of LONGS were force-sold against 9,085 of shorts. Confidence rises 6.5 to 6.75 on structure - the 03 September daily bar settled 81,260.1, +5.07 percent, and the daily MACD histogram crossed positive - not on the entry, which is worse than it was at midday.

overnightRisk: Six and a half hours of no coverage into the thinnest liquidity of the day, with price 1,001 points off a high it just failed to hold. Five specific things to watch. ONE - the 82,285.0 rejection: the last two hours produced 1,361,691 USD of LONG liquidations against 9,085 of short, a complete inversion of the 9.8-to-1 short-side flow that defined the rest of the day, so the leverage that is now dying is the leverage that chased the breakout. TWO - the air pocket: between 80,000 and 79,750 there is no liquidation shelf and no moving average, and 79,750 holds 4,596,872 USD of the day's cluster, so a break of 80,750 travels fast to a real magnet 1,000 points lower. That is exactly what the 80,700 resting stop exists for. THREE - US non-farm payrolls print Friday 04 September at 12:30 UTC, after tomorrow's midnight and morning reports; positioning ahead of it thins the book overnight and the whole September rate-cut trade that drove today's 1.19 percent QQQ session runs through that number. FOUR - Brent at 95.67 and rising on Iran headlines: an overnight crude spike is the cleanest path to a risk-off gap, and the dollar has already ticked back up to 98.993 with the 10-year at 4.764. FIVE - IBIT's 03 September flow is still unreported on Farside; today's +301.6m net inflow is built without the largest fund, so a negative IBIT print tomorrow morning would materially weaken the flow story that is currently carrying half the bullish case. Funding settles at 08:00 UTC at +0.0000526 with the perp premium still negative at -0.0003813, so longs are not yet paying a punitive carry - that is the one thing working in favour of holding through the gap.

liquidityMagnet.note: Balanced rather than up, and the reason is a genuine conflict in the data. The static picture says up: the 82,000 bucket is the biggest on the board at 10,751,916 USD, the account ratio is 0.89 with more short accounts than long, and the perp premium is still negative at -0.0003813, all of which describes a market that is short into strength. The flow picture says down: in the final two hours the liquidation tape inverted completely, 1,361,691 USD of longs against 9,085 of shorts, and the 82,285.0 high was rejected by 1,001 points. When the position data and the flow data disagree this sharply, calling a direction is guessing. The honest statement is that 82,000 and 80,750 are both live and whichever breaks first on a settled hourly close gets the follow-through.

liquidations.note: 3,990 unique filled OKX BTC-USDT-SWAP liquidations across 23.65 hours to 2026-09-04T00:16:23Z, newest fill 19.5 minutes old; contract size 0.01 BTC. Shorts 52,762,484 USD against longs 5,398,324 - a 9.8-to-1 ratio over the full day. The important number is not that ratio but its inversion at the end: in the final two hours the tape produced 1,361,691 USD of LONG liquidations against 9,085 of short, concentrated in the 81,000 and 80,750 buckets. skew is the OKX long/short ACCOUNT ratio at 0.89 on the 00:00 UTC bar, the lowest print of the day, with 0.90, 0.89, 0.92, 0.92, 0.91, 0.90, 0.90 across the preceding hours - shorts stayed crowded through the entire advance and got a little more crowded after the rejection. Open interest rose a further 4,978,788 USD to 2,396,490,672 and funding ticked UP to +0.0000526021041453 for the 08:00 UTC settlement from +0.0000462290754657 at midday, while the perp premium stayed NEGATIVE at -0.0003813164766851. Longs are paying slightly more than they were and the perp still trades at a discount to spot, so this remains a spot-led advance rather than a leveraged one - but the marginal buyer is now paying up, which is the first small crack in that argument.

calibration.rollingRecord: Settled-close gates 6 for 7 this week; the discretionary overlay on top of them 0 for 5.
calibration.note: The streak broke. The midday ADD gate at 81,500.0 armed on the 19:00 UTC hourly close at 81,768.9, price extended 516.1 points to 82,285.0, and it is now 81,283.9 - 485.0 points BELOW the trigger. That is the first settled-close gate to fail after six straight successes, and it failed in the mildest possible way: it armed near a local high rather than at one, and the give-back is 0.59 percent. The midday REDUCE gate at 80,000.0 was never approached; the low since was 80,896.8, 896.8 points of clearance, so priorReduceFired is false. actingHelped is FALSE but the margin is a rounding error - the midday session trimmed 12 percent of the spot core at 81,051.0 and spot marks 81,283.9, so the slice was sold 232.9 points early, roughly 0.06 USDT on the size involved. The honest reading of today is that the gates carried the wallet through a 5.5 percent day and only gave a fraction of it back at the very end. The lesson worth writing down is about the add gate, not the trim: a settled-close breakout trigger placed 449 points BELOW an untested twenty-four-hour high is a trigger that arms into the last thrust rather than after it. Tomorrow's add gate is set 15 points ABOVE the high for exactly that reason.
